title: Self-product right-adjoint base change at a complex with local derived categories
statement: Let f:X→S be proper, flat and locally of finite presentation between Noetherian schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-flat-morphism]. Specify derived-category localizations [def-pc-derived-category] only for S, X and P=X×_S X [def-pc-base-change]. Let hRf, hRpr2 and hLpr1 assert preservation of quasi-coherent cohomology by the restricted derived direct images Rf*, Rpr2* [def-pc-derived-direct-image] and derived pullback Lpr1* [def-pc-derived-pullback]. Let a and b be chosen right adjoints to these restricted direct images. For any K in D_QCoh(S) whose derived pullback Lf*K has quasi-coherent cohomology, b(Lf*K) is isomorphic to Lpr1*a(K) in D_QCoh(P). The membership witness for Lf*K only types this expression.

proof.text: Use the localization universal property to compare the specified localizations with standard choices for all schemes. The left- and right-derived universal properties compare derived pullback and direct image, and the cohomology comparisons restrict these equivalences to D_QCoh. Transport the adjunctions and use right-adjoint uniqueness. Apply proper_flat_rightAdjoint_baseChange with g=f, evaluate at K, and invert the resulting isomorphism; transport it back. No identification of Lf*K with a structure sheaf is involved.

theorem proper_flat_selfProduct_rightAdjoint_baseChange_local
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian S]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace))]
    (f : X ⟶ S) [Flat f] [IsProper f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u}
      (moduleRings (Limits.pullback f f).toRingedSpace))]
    (hRf : ∀ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X,
      schemeDerivedQCohProperty S ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj E.obj))
    (hRpr₂ : ∀ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory (Limits.pullback f f),
      schemeDerivedQCohProperty X
        ((schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f f)).obj E.obj))
    (hLpr₁ : ∀ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X,
      schemeDerivedQCohProperty (Limits.pullback f f)
        ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst f f)).obj E.obj))
    (a : schemeDerivedQCohCategory S ⥤ schemeDerivedQCohCategory X)
    (b : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X ⥤ schemeDerivedQCohCategory (Limits.pullback f f))
    (adjA : (schemeDerivedQCohProperty S).lift
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty X).ι ⋙ schemeDerivedDirectImage f) hRf ⊣ a)
    (adjB : (schemeDerivedQCohProperty X).lift
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty (Limits.pullback f f)).ι ⋙
        schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f f)) hRpr₂ ⊣ b)
    (K : schemeDerivedQCohCategory S)
    (hLfK : schemeDerivedQCohProperty X ((derivedPullback f).obj K.obj)) :
    Nonempty
      (b.obj ⟨(derivedPullback f).obj K.obj, hLfK⟩ ≅
        ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty (Limits.pullback f f)).lift
          ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty X).ι ⋙ derivedPullback (pullback.fst f f))
          hLpr₁).obj (a.obj K))
